dedupe_keys.name: renovation planner methods and architecture of a decision support tool for building retrofit

description: Sara Abouebeid and colleagues at Chalmers University publish Renovation Planner documentation for building retrofit and energy-community planning with coverage of Sweden and the United Kingdom. The September 2026 Zenodo files describe stock-data matching, TABULA archetypes, EnergyPlus baselines, renovation scenarios, cost and carbon assessment, and uncertainty analysis. Documentation is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The linked code repository provides a React interface and backend connections, but its current LICENSE is proprietary and requires the owner’s prior agreement. This conflicts with the Zenodo statement that code is MIT-licensed; software reuse and cost therefore require enquiry. The documented methods can guide retrofit simulations, while a working interface alone does not establish an operational analysis backend. Related catalogue records model-energyplus and data-tabula-episcope-building-typologies describe dependencies. External building datasets are separately licensed. Code execution, data-service access and numerical validity were not checked.
